path.description: The file just edited, absolute or relative to the workspace root.

paths.description: Several edited files, instead of or as well as path.

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait at most (default 10000). What is known by then is returned, with why it may be out of date.

build_check.description: When to run the workspace's check task (for Zig `zig build check`): if_no_server (default) when no language server checks the file, always, or never.
